result:
If I could change one thing, I'd hardwire every human with an instinctive, visceral intolerance for self-deception.

Not "more empathy." Not "less greed." Not even "more intelligence." Just an automatic, uncomfortable reaction whenever their mind starts twisting reality to protect ego, tribe, or comfort. The same gut-level rejection you feel when you touch something hot.

Most of the world's stupidity, cruelty, and self-sabotage isn't because people are evil or dumb. It's because they're extremely good at lying to themselves and then building entire civilizations on those lies. Remove that one feature, and a lot of the rest starts fixing itself. People would still disagree, still compete, still suffer. But they'd do it while actually seeing what they're doing.
